profile.headline: Front-end development at Gibobs allbanks
profile.summary:
As a Frontend Developer, I apply my expertise in ReactJS, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML to create stunning and user-friendly websites that showcase the company's innovative banking solutions. I have over three years of experience in frontend development, working with various frameworks, libraries, and tools to deliver high-quality and interactive web applications.

In my current role, I collaborate with the design team to implement their UI mockups and wireframes, using animations, modals, form validations, and other dynamic features. I also ensure the website is responsive and compatible with different devices and screen sizes, and provide ongoing support for bug fixing and maintenance. I am passionate about web development and always eager to learn new technologies and best practices.

- Ensure the website is responsive and compatible with various devices and screen sizes.
- Collaborate with the design team to create visually appealing and user-friendly UI mockups and wireframes.
- Provide ongoing support for bug fixing and website maintenance post-launch.
